name: GSS
fix_description: In _tokenTransfer1, the fee distribution logic causes token balance in the LP pair to diverge from reserves. Fees are transferred from sender to various receivers but the accounting causes pair.balanceOf(token) > reserve, allowing attacker to call pair.skim() to extract the excess. Fix: ensure fee transfers do not create balance/reserve discrepancy in the pair, or call sync() after fee operations.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short PoC, but the exploit is not just a trivial access-control bug: it combines a flash loan, a fee-on-transfer token swap, and UniswapV2-style pair reserve manipulation using transfer/skim/sync across two pools. An auditor would need to understand pair accounting and protocol-specific token/pool behavior, but the attack path is still only a few steps and not deeply complex.
